description: This file defines a database migration class for Android's Room persistence library, specifically migrating database version 11 to 12 by adding new columns to the 'ACCOUNTS' table and updating capabilities.

classes.name: Migration_11_12
classes.description: A Room database migration class that adds new columns to the 'ACCOUNTS' table and updates capabilities during migration.

methods.name: Migration_11_12
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the migration with source version 11 and target version 12, and stores the application context.

methods.name: migrate
methods.description: Executes SQL commands to add new columns for API version and theme colors to the 'ACCOUNTS' table, then calls CapabilitiesWorker.update.
